# GanttChartElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasGanttChartElement` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasGanttChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasGanttChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasGanttChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A project schedule: task table, dependencies, milestones, critical path

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasSmoothScroll](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasSmoothScroll.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasGanttChartElement> CreateGanttChartElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasGanttChartElement> CreateGanttChartWithData( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, std::shared_ptr<GanttDataSource> data, GanttDesign design = GanttDesign::Modern, const std::string& title = "");
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasGanttChartElement(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onTaskClick` | `std::function<void(int taskId)> onTaskClick` | _Task click_ |
| `onTaskDoubleClick` | `std::function<void(int taskId)> onTaskDoubleClick` | _Task double click_ |
| `onTaskToggled` | `std::function<void(int taskId, bool expanded)> onTaskToggled` | _Task toggled_ |
| `onSelectionChanged` | `std::function<void(int taskId)> onSelectionChanged` | 1 = cleared |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md): `SetCustomTooltipGenerator`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### struct `GanttDate`

Calendar date stored as a serial day count since 1970-01-01 (proleptic Gregorian, can be negative). Cheap to copy and compare; conversions use the CalendarDate helpers shared with the calendar heatmap.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `serial` | `long serial = 0` |  |

Methods: `FromYMD`, `ToYMD`, `Year`, `Month`, `Day`, `Weekday`, `IsWeekend`, `AddDays`, `DaysUntil`
